trackDescription: Open source, on your machine • No AWS account, no card, no bill

environmentProblemTrack.problemDescription: Close the loop on what a city throws away and cut what it burns. Eliminating agricultural post-harvest food waste and municipal landfill methane emissions, connecting informal street vendors to surplus produce, and cutting diesel transport energy.

project.name: KrishiFlow
project.tagline: Autonomous Fair-Price Agricultural Procurement & Zero-Waste Food Network
project.elevatorPitch: KrishiFlow solves the $14B post-harvest food waste crisis in rural India by pairing farmers directly with mandi buyers and surplus food processors. It runs 100% locally on developer machines and edge mandi nodes without an AWS account, card, or cloud bill, powered by open-source AWS technologies including Strands Agents, Finch, SAM CLI, LocalStack, Corretto 21, OpenSearch, and Cedar policies.

agentsAndAi.implementation: Multi-agent orchestration simulating FarmerAgent, MandiMatcherAgent, and LogisticsAgent with deterministic task decomposition and PartyRock prompt chains.

containersAndKubernetes.implementation: Open-source Finch container engine running local microservices and EKS Distro manifests for mandi hub nodes without Docker Desktop licensing.

serverless.implementation: SAM CLI template (template.yaml) configured to emulate API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB offline via LocalStack at localhost:4566.

serversAndRuntimes.implementation: Amazon Corretto 21 JVM runtime with Firecracker microVM specs providing sub-120ms boot times and 5MB cold-start footprints for village kiosks.

dataAndSearch.implementation: OpenSearch cluster indexing mandi produce lots with BM25 keyword search and vector semantic search for crop disease and grade discovery.

authAndPolicy.implementation: Formal Cedar authorization policies (policies.cedar) governing role-based access for Farmers, Krishi Mitras, Wholesalers, and Drivers.

thePlumbing.implementation: Zero-cloud spend event-driven architecture using local coroutine queues and LocalStack EventBridge emulation.
